title: STORAGE HUNTERS INF MONEY METHOD 5 HOUR 100K
features: I couldn't find anyone who had written a script for this game, so I wrote one myself. Here's how it works: First, you set your teleportation location, and then using the K, J, and H keys, you can quickly teleport to your house, your field, or other locations with a single keystroke—without having to drive at all. This way, I've gone from a 2k vehicle to 500k right now.
